task.prompt: Perform static source analysis of TenantCache.cs itself against the behavioral contract in README.md. This is a deliberately flawed snapshot, not a git-diff review: ignore git status, read both files, and inspect the actual implementation line by line for concrete contract violations. Do not modify files. Return only JSON with this shape: {"findings":[{"file":"path","line":1,"severity":"critical|high|medium|low","title":"short title","summary":"why this is a defect","evidence":"specific behavior"}]}. Report every supported actionable defect, but do not invent style findings; line is the most relevant source line.
